skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role and position of marketing in agricultural businesses, grasp the marketing process, and make effective marketing decisions.
Understand the role of information in making marketing decisions and how to collect and analyze information.
Understand the marketing environment, including micro and macro factors, and their impact on marketing decisions.
Understand and apply marketing strategies and tactics, including the STP framework and the 4Ps.
Practice group work and analyze marketing activities at a specific agricultural business.
Understand the social context, professional ethics, and social responsibility.
